chapters.title: The Lord Slow to Anger
chapters.synopsis: Nahum's burden declares that the Lord is slow to anger and great in power, but will not at all acquit the wicked, taking vengeance on his adversaries with whirlwind and storm. Though he is a stronghold to those who trust in him, the Lord has determined the utter end of Nineveh and promises good tidings of peace to Judah.

chapters.title: Nineveh's Fall Foretold
chapters.synopsis: Nahum describes the besieger coming up against Nineveh, with chariots raging in the streets and the river gates opened before the invaders. The great city empties like a broken pool as her people flee, and the Lord declares himself against the lion's den that once devoured many nations.

chapters.title: Woe to the Bloody City
chapters.synopsis: The Lord pronounces woe on Nineveh, the bloody city full of lies and robbery, exposing her harlotries before all nations. Nahum reminds the city of No, which likewise fell despite its strength, and declares that Nineveh's shepherds now slumber, her people scattered upon the mountains with none to gather them, her wound incurable.
